outlined.rule: the paper box of a view reads the fill (shape:<id>) and every visible outline run (outline:<id>:<n>) of its shapes, so a part drawn unfilled is measured

landmarks.rule: an anchor lies on the drawn shapes of its bone or of a descendant bone, in every view in which its bone is drawn; shapes of an ancestor or of another branch do not count

boneSync.rule: the hard per-bone tier holds for a shape and its twin of the same id; a bone whose single shapes in two views carry different ids, or that has several shapes in a view, is reported as group-drift (D48)

cases.name: twin of the same id that agrees

analysisCue.rule: one rule for thermal, forces and moments: a scene without hatch pattern and dashed stroke is accepted only when its legend states in English and German the share below which a value is drawn unhatched; a strong member diagram is hatched by its sign

generator.rule: one record per asset written when it ends; a rerun skips current records; shards merge; a crash or timeout inside an asset is a named failure with its message, never a silent cell-missing
